description:
## Question

Assemble every resolved decision into a single implementable spec — the destination of this map.

Must contain:
- The workflow topology: files, triggers, jobs, and the data flowing between them.
- The affected-set computation, spelled out concretely enough to implement without re-deciding anything.
- The mass-rebuild gate: trigger rule, approval mechanism, prompt text, and the local commands the human runs to pre-populate.
- What the human must change outside the repo (branch protection, environment configuration, secrets).
- The rollout plan and how to verify the new pipeline is correct before removing the old one.
- Explicitly: what this spec does *not* cover (darwin CI coverage, fork PRs).

Land it as a committed markdown document (`docs/adr/` or `docs/`), linked from this ticket.
title: Write the CI design spec
